metadata.subset: Largest 1,500 mapped mining-land polygons by original area; navigation points, not a list of mines or tailings facilities.
metadata.position_method: Interior representative point computed from native WGS84 polygon; native area retained without recalculation.
metadata.uncertainty: Visual interpretation of 2019 10 m Sentinel-2 imagery within study search zones; source overall land-cover validation accuracy 88.3%. Not an exhaustive all-mine census.
